biryani: A plate of biryani, a spiced mixed rice dish layered with meat or vegetables.
cholebhature: A plate of chole bhature, spiced chickpea curry served with fried bread.
dabeli: A dabeli, a spiced potato filling in a bun, a popular Indian street food snack.
dal: A bowl of dal, a spiced Indian lentil curry.
dhokla: A plate of dhokla, a steamed savory cake made from fermented rice and chickpea batter.
dosa: A dosa, a thin crispy fermented rice and lentil crepe, a South Indian dish.
jalebi: A plate of jalebi, a spiral-shaped deep-fried sweet soaked in sugar syrup.
kathiroll: A kathi roll, a wrap filled with spiced meat or vegetables, a popular Indian street food.
kofta: A plate of kofta, fried vegetable or meat balls in a spiced curry sauce.
naan: Naan, a soft leavened flatbread baked in a tandoor oven.
pakora: A plate of pakora, deep-fried vegetable fritters in spiced chickpea batter.
paneer: A dish of paneer, a fresh Indian cheese, often cooked in a spiced curry sauce.
panipuri: Pani puri, crispy hollow puris filled with spiced tangy water and potato, a popular street food.
pavbhaji: Pav bhaji, a spiced vegetable mash served with a soft buttered bread roll.
vadapav: Vada pav, a spiced fried potato patty served in a bread bun, a popular Mumbai street food.
